# `docs`

Product/work-item planning skills (no agents): write-prd, prd-to-work-items.

## Prerequisites

- The [GitHub Copilot CLI](https://github.com/github/copilot-cli) (or Agency) with this marketplace added (see **Install** below).

`prd-to-work-items` optionally needs the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/) (`gh`) to create GitHub issues, or the [Azure CLI](https://learn.microsoft.com/cli/azure/) (`az`) to create Azure DevOps work items. `write-prd` needs nothing extra.

## Install

Add the marketplace once, then install this plugin:

```bash
copilot plugin marketplace add Menny1337/copilot-plugins
copilot plugin install docs@menny1337-plugins
```

Update later with `copilot plugin update docs@menny1337-plugins` (or `plugins-update` to refresh everything). See the [repository README](../../README.md) for per-session Agency profiles, aliases, and global-install options.
